source: CTO-provided dropdown_options.csv, supplied verbatim by Zoeb 2026-08-02. Spelling, punctuation, capitalisation and wording preserved exactly — do not invent, abbreviate, reword or add values.
fieldTarget: Sales Pro "Business Types" (Multi Select). Multiple approved values are joined with ", " — never more than one principal value plus up to two genuinely relevant secondary values.
scopeRule: Apply only to final qualified ordinary leads and key accounts. Excluded, held, review_required, and rejected candidates do not receive a value.
eligibilityNotes: Café / Coffee Shop is an approved CRM value, but conventional cafés/coffee shops are excluded from this campaign when café/coffee is the principal operation — this value should not normally appear in a released row. It remains valid for a business where café/coffee service is genuinely secondary to an eligible principal operation.
Ice Cream Shop / Dessert Café is not automatically excluded.
A restaurant, bakery, takeaway or dessert business is not excluded merely because it sells coffee.

Dedicated bubble-tea/boba/milk-tea operators are excluded where drinks are the principal operation. A sushi restaurant, dessert business, or broader food operator remains eligible where bubble tea is only a secondary offering.

CTO Business Type classification must not override the separate business-category eligibility decision — eligibility is decided first, independently; this vocabulary is applied only after a candidate is already eligible.
